newsitem.title: USA: Three killed in Minnesota school bus accident.
newsitem.headline: Three killed in Minnesota school bus accident.

text.p: Two children and an adult were killed and a number of others critically injured on Thursday when a school bus and a gravel truck collided at an intersection, police said.
The Wright County sheriff's office said road conditions were clear at the time and the cause of the accident was not known.
One student on the Monticello School District bus was killed in the crash and a second died later at a hospital. The truck driver was pronounced dead at the scene.
There were 14 to 16 students on the bus and "there were a number of injuries, some critical," the sheriff's office said. Some of the victims were airlifted to area hospitals.

Investigators said the truck pulled into the intersection of two county roads as the bus approached and was struck in the passenger side of the cab by the bus. Initial reports said the truck had a stop sign while the bus was on a through road.
Monticello is a village on Interstate 94 about 40 miles northwest of Minneapolis.
